'''Warmalo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Calimondra appointed him to become her new director of metallurgical operations. Following the [[Siege of Calimondretta]], he escaped aboard [[Parlan Spinner]]'s ship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] along with several [[Arkadianate]] citizens, who wanted to escape the Arkadianate.
